did_you_know.text: The place-name 'Bethel' means 'House of God'; in Genesis it is Jacob's dream site and at various times served as a cultic center in the hill country.
Manasseh and Ephraim are the two half‑tribes of Joseph; in later biblical usage 'Ephraim' often stands for the whole northern Israel region, not just the single tribe.

The verse says the Canaanite was not expelled and 'became a subject paying tribute' — this means local inhabitants remained and sometimes worked for or paid taxes to the new rulers, a common outcome after conquests in the ancient Near East.
